segments.summary: Reviewed denial payloads, mutation recovery, Firecrawl ownership, identity, configuration, and endpoint inventory; the principal adversarial gap is the missing API-key lifecycle contract.

Reviewed provider capability exclusions, extract/research/search transforms, crawl/cache/change tracking, browser endpoint boundaries, and batch row coverage; crawl expansion and robots authority remain underspecified.

Reviewed asynchronous lifecycle, cancellation, cost routing, ZDR/billing disclosure, interact sessions, audit traceability, and deployment permissions; restart, race, privacy-lifecycle, and budget-concurrency gaps remain.

Reviewed errors, provider-stack defaults, capability tiering, Exa fallback, DDG/Google boundaries, provider disclosures, and Tavily settings; fallback termination and status accessibility are incomplete.
Reviewed Tavily economics, support vocabulary, operation matrix, model-native identity, routing, activity labels, and provenance strength; deterministic adapter tie-breaking is not specified.

Reviewed cost/completion auditing, dispatcher consumers, research authority, batch failures and permissions, concurrency/timeout, and two-phase cache validation; in-flight, domain-grant, and cache-snapshot semantics are incomplete.
Reviewed cache actions/diffs/storage, Tools SSOT boundaries, blocked notice propagation, and runtime attribution; cache atomicity plus exact blocked-notice and attribution schemas remain unresolved.

Reviewed the Tools migration ownership boundary, the retired generated T-001 residual and migration coverage tail, and T-157 structural/registry recovery; inbound anchor compatibility lacks a machine oracle.
